title: Pan-Seared Prawns with Tiger Fried Rice
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of Slovakia with a twist of Asian cuisine.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Remove the prawns from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and the buttery slovakian seasoning.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the seasoning.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is heated through.
Return the prawns to the skillet and stir to combine with the rice.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley and a fried egg if desired.
